rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] took the long way back from the fields, and neither of them hurried.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] saved [RECIPIENT_nameDef] the warm seat at supper, and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] noticed.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about [topic] until the others had gone to bed.
topic->nothing in particular
topic->where they'd each like to be in ten years
topic->the stars, badly
topic->the best meal either of them had ever eaten
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] brought [RECIPIENT_nameDef] [gift], and said it was nothing.
gift->a sprig of something that smelled sweet
gift->the last of the good bread
gift->a smooth stone from the river
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] made [RECIPIENT_nameDef] laugh twice at supper, and looked pleased with [INITIATOR_objective]self both times.
r_logentry->Long after supper, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] were still at the washing-up.
topic->the songs they knew as children
gift->a bird whittled from a stick
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] both turned up to help with the same small job, and stared at each other over it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef], quite politely, to keep [RECIPIENT_possessive] distance. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] said the same back.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] agreed, stiffly, that whoever was chosen, they'd shake hands on it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] straight out what [RECIPIENT_possessive] intentions were, and got a straight answer.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] had a short, careful conversation about nothing, while both of them watched the same door.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] admitted to [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that this was ridiculous. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] agreed, and neither of them backed down.
r_logentry->Stuck on the same job all morning, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] were scrupulously polite to each other.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over the day's work, the teacher and the student, every piece of it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about whether the other student got more attention, at length and honestly.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked through what the student does better than anyone, and what still needs work.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] had it out about favorites at the bench, and came away agreeing there weren't any.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] sat over a spoiled piece of work and worked out where it went wrong, without blame.
r_logentry->Before supper, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] agreed on what the student would practice next, and why.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef], who learn at the same bench, compared what the teacher had told each of them. It wasn't the same thing.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] showed [RECIPIENT_nameDef] a trick the teacher hadn't. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] showed one back.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] stopped competing for a whole afternoon and got twice as much done.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] admitted to [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that [RECIPIENT_pronoun] had the steadier hand. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] admitted [INITIATOR_nameDef] had the better eye.
r_logentry->Out of the teacher's earshot, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] traded the teacher's favorite sayings and laughed.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] fixed each other's mistakes before the teacher could see them.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef], parent and child, sat on the step and talked about the quarrel in the family.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went through the whole quarrel, one side at a time, without interrupting each other.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about brothers and sisters, and what they owe each other.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] walked out past the fields and came back calmer.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] remembered an old family quarrel that had ended well, and how.
r_logentry->Over a basket of mending, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked the quarrel through without looking up much.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the falling-out, and the one in the middle mostly listened.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] not to make anyone choose sides. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] said that was fair.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] agreed that it had gone on long enough, and couldn't agree on who should say so first.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] carried a word from one friend to another and told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] it faithfully, with the sharp bits left out.
r_logentry->Over supper, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the old days, when the three of them got on.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] how tiring it was to be in the middle. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] hadn't thought of that.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the travelers at the camp, and where they were going next.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] whether [RECIPIENT_pronoun] ever thought about just leaving one morning. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] said everyone does.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] sat on the wall and looked at the camp's smoke, and talked about roads.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] what the camp's people had said about the lands to the south. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] said it sounded like a lot of walking.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about what keeps a person in one place, and listed it, and the list was longer than either expected.
r_logentry->Late into the evening, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the road, and about home.

InteractionDef.label: gave some advice on the office

rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the council: who listens, who only talks, and how to tell.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] how you make a hard call and sleep afterwards. The answer was "badly, at first".
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over the office's duties together, one by one, over a pot of something hot.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that nobody is ready for a seat on the council, and everybody has to pretend.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the first mistake each of them made in charge of something.
r_logentry->On the back of an old tally, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] wrote down who to ask about what.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about family far away, and the news from out there.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] about someone [INITIATOR_pronoun] hasn't seen in years, and couldn't stop.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over every scrap of news from the road, looking for good in it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] how you stop worrying about people you can't reach. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] didn't know either, and said so.
r_logentry->Long after the others were asleep, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] sat up with the worry between them.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] wrote out a letter together, to be sent with the next trader who would take it.

InteractionDef.label: sat up after a bad dream

rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] sat up together after a bad dream, until the shaking stopped.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about what lives in the dark, and decided together that nothing much does.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] made up a story about a brave mouse, which went on for some time.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] checked under the bed, and behind the door, and agreed it was all clear.
r_logentry->Lying in the dark, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] counted the sounds of the colony at night until one of them fell asleep.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] left a small light burning, and talked about the morning instead.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] argued about the work, and for once it was an argument between equals.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] for [RECIPIENT_possessive] opinion, and then actually listened to it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about what [INITIATOR_nameDef] had made, plainly, without "for your age" anywhere in it.
r_logentry->Halfway through a job, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] both said sorry for the shouting at the same moment, and laughed.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked late, the young one and the old one, about what each wanted from the other.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] worked out a fair share of the work between them, like two grown people.

InteractionDef.label: took the baby for a while

rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] took turns walking the baby up and down until it slept.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] everything [INITIATOR_pronoun] knew about babies, which was less than [INITIATOR_pronoun] thought.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked in whispers by the cradle about nothing much, so as not to wake it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] agreed that the baby looks like everyone in the family and no one at all.
r_logentry->While the baby slept, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] shared a cold supper and called it a feast.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] worked out who would take the baby which nights, and wrote it down so nobody could argue.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about what should happen to the old one's things, when the time comes. It wasn't sad, mostly.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] walked to the place by the graves where the old one would like to lie, and agreed it had a good view.
r_logentry->One by one, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went through a box of old things, and the stories came out with them.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about who should have the tools, and who would only lose them.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] sat together without saying much, then talked about the weather.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about what the old one wanted said, and what they'd rather was left out.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] remembered the first winter here, and argued about which of them was colder.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] named the people who were here when they came, one by one, and who was left.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] complained at length about how the young ones do everything wrong.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] remembered the same raid differently, and agreed to disagree on the details.
r_logentry->In the sun by the wall, [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] sat out an afternoon and said very little.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about an old quarrel between them and couldn't remember what it had been about.
